items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And Billy Taylor has a wonderful Woman in Jazz Festival at the Kennedy Center. You know, but he’s doing it for the right reason.

ctx.x: Well it’s like referring to Marian McPartland as “one of the best of the women jazz musicians.”

Yeah. And still today. You know and certain clubs that shall remain nameless, but trying to get a gig there is, you might get a night on a “Woman in Jazz” week. You know and it’s kind of like wow, you still have those? Well I guess we do. And Billy Taylor has a wonderful Woman in Jazz Festival at the Kennedy Center. You know, but he’s doing it for the right reason. He’s doing it because he wants to highlight women leaders more. You know, so it’s not only women playing. And of course I’m friends with everybody in…
Well do you think it would get to the point where the Diva big band could just be the something-else big band. I mean the title of the band calls attention to the fact that this is an all-women band.
